'''2022 PC20 Brad Eier DS ROPSv''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brad Eier]] at [[2022 PC20 Tournament]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Brad Eier]]
* '''Event:''' [[2022 PC20 Tournament]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Ralltiir Operations (V) Eier DS.txt |Download]]
